## Problem

What is hard or missing today?

## Proposal

What should the app do instead? Keep it concrete.

## Why here

Does this belong in the local Streamlit + LangGraph app, or is it a new product?

## Out of scope (please do not ask)

- Hosted multi-user service or auth
- Donation / sponsorship features
- Changing the locked provider model lists without a strong reason
- Unrestricted code execution

## Extra

Any API, file, or page you already looked at (`app_pages/…`, `graph.py`, …).
